name: nullchat-mobile
description: Builds the NullChat Android and iPhone apps: your NullChat website inside Capacitor's native shell, plus phone notifications.

scripts.android:add: node scripts/configure.mjs && cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/configure.mjs && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && cap sync android
scripts.ios:add: node scripts/configure.mjs && cap add ios --packagemanager SPM && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: node scripts/configure.mjs && node scripts/patch-ios.mjs && cap sync ios
